crossRefs.note: He went forward a little, fell on his face, and prayed, saying, “My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass away…
He went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass away from…

translations.web: He was withdrawn from them about a stone’s throw, and he knelt down and prayed,
translations.bsb: And He withdrew about a stone’s throw beyond them, where He knelt down and prayed,
translations.kjv: And he was withdrawn from them about a stone's cast, and kneeled down, and prayed,
translations.asv: And he was parted from them about a stone's cast; and he kneeled down and prayed,
